release_notes: Build 160 fixes Quiz Release Automation STA failures by keeping WPF quiz card and thumbnail rendering on the desktop UI dispatcher.
Build 159 corrected the desktop build number shown in the application to match the released build metadata.
Build 158 quiz card rendering thread fix remains included: WPF quiz card builds are dispatched to the desktop UI thread.
Build 157 configuration backup recovery and Build 156 database credential recovery remain intact.
